case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70710.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
sup:70710.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for the transparency on your cost drivers. We value the working relationship and would like to close this on a clear footing.

Our own records show a different picture:

Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

Against that background, we have structured three options that should be easy to take to your pricing committee. All run for a longer contract term than you proposed.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.82; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.93; no index clause; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

If your approval needs further detail from us, we are glad to provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have verified your records regarding our past pricing and delivery performance, which allows us to adjust our position. 

We are prepared to agree to the 24-month contract term proposed in your Option C. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. However, a contract of this duration requires the inclusion of an AS-14404 index clause, bringing our proposed unit price to EUR 5.37. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.29 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.37 per unit. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Option B: unit price EUR 4.85; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

If your approval process needs anything further from us, please let us know and we will provide it.

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €5.38 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We appreciate your inclusion of the AS-14404 index clause, which provides the necessary stability for a 24-month contract. This offer represents a significant concession and reflects our commitment to developing our partnership. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

As an alternative package beside our current offer, we can propose a price of €5.25 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.25 per unit.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
